metered.notes: Request overage is TIERED, published in the pricing calculator's 'How is this calculated?' panel: first 10k free, then $0.0007/request (10,001-30,000), $0.00035 (30,001-90,000), $0.000175 (90,001-250,000), $0.0000875 (250,001-800,000), $0.00004375 (800,001-2.5M), $0.00002 above 2.5M. The flat 'overage' field holds only the first paid tier ($0.70 per 1k) because MeteredPricing has no tier support, so a flat calculation overstates cost at volume; use 'tiers' if the estimator gains tier support. Storage is billed separately (1 GB free, then $3.25/GB for the first 30 GB, falling to $0.50/GB above 450 GB; the calculator assumes 4 bytes per token). Hobby keeps logging past 10k but requires an upgrade to view the requests, so it is treated as capped.

gatewayFees.byok: $25,000 of list price inference / month with no fees, 5% fee after (Standard and Business; Enterprise custom)
gatewayFees.notes: Fee is charged when credits are bought, not per request: 5.5% on Standard (pay-as-you-go), 8% on Business, fee discounts on Enterprise. The pricing page publishes no fixed per-purchase fee, so fixedUsd is omitted. Payment by card, crypto (USDC) and more on Standard/Business; no separate crypto fee is listed.

embeddings.notes: Cheapest current model and the one every embeddings-guide example uses; dims from https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/embeddings. text-embedding-3-large is $0.13 (3072 dims). No batch price is listed for embeddings on the pricing page.
General-purpose model per https://docs.voyageai.com/docs/embeddings (default 1024 dims; 256/512/2048 available). First 200M tokens free.
Cheapest current Voyage model; first 200M tokens free.

Jina sells prepaid token packages shared across all its APIs and models, not per-model rates: $50 for 1B tokens (page states $0.050 / 1M) or $500 for 11B tokens ($0.045 / 1M, premium key). The $0.05 rate is the smallest paid package. Model and 1024 dims from https://jina.ai/models/jina-embeddings-v5-text-small/; the page does not name a single default model.
Model page id mistral-embed-23-12; cached input $0.01/1M. Codestral Embed is $0.15/1M. Default dimensions not stated on the pricing page.
